sloka: भक्ष्यम् भोज्यम् च पेयम् च लेह्यम् च इदम् उपस्थितम् ।शयनानि च मुख्यानि वाजिनाम् खादनम् च ते ॥२-५०-३९॥
transliteration: bhakṣyam bhojyam ca peyam ca lehyam ca idam upasthitam ।śayanāni ca mukhyāni vājinām khādanam ca te ॥2-50-39॥

translations.english: "We are your servants and your honour is our lord; rule our kingdom well. Food to chew and to eat, to drink and to lick, is ready, and choice couches for you, and fodder for the horses."
